materials: Salt or sugar, water, jar, string

name: Make a Pinhole Camera
howTo: Pinhole in a dark box projects an inverted image. Optics: light travels in straight lines.
materials: Dark box, foil, pin, tracing paper

name: Soap Making (Cold Process, Simplified)
howTo: Glycerine melt-and-pour soap with added scent and colour. Chemistry: saponification principle accessible version.
materials: Glycerine soap base, essential oil, colour, mould

name: Textile Printing (Screen)
howTo: Stretch fabric over a frame; apply paint through a stencil. Screen printing is industrial design made accessible.

name: Budget for a Week's Meals
howTo: Plan a week of meals for the family within a set budget. Arithmetic + nutrition knowledge + planning combined.

name: Cook from a Recipe (Independently)
howTo: Choose a recipe, gather ingredients, cook from start to finish without help. Culinary literacy + independence.

name: Field Sport (60 Minutes)
howTo: Play a full 60-minute session of a team sport with proper rules, positions, and substitutions.

name: Swim: Flip Turn
howTo: Tumble turn at the pool wall: flip, push, glide, resume stroke. Technical swimming milestone.

name: Cycling: Descent Control
howTo: Control speed on a long downhill: brake timing, body position, steering. Downhill safety = motor + judgement.

name: Gymnastics: Walkover or Backbend
howTo: Back walkover or front walkover. Full spinal flexibility + weight-bearing in back-extended position.

name: Athletics: 800m Run (Paced)
howTo: Run 800 m with pacing strategy: don't sprint the first lap. Pacing is a cognitive and physical skill simultaneously.

name: Basketball Dribble and Shoot
howTo: Dribble around a defender and shoot. Game-like combination rather than isolated skill practice.

name: Surfing (If Coastal) or Bodyboard
howTo: Balance on a moving water surface. The most demanding vestibular and proprioceptive challenge available.

name: Martial Arts Sparring (Light)
howTo: Supervised light sparring. Reading an opponent + responding in real time = the highest-level motor planning.

name: Write a Complete Short Story
howTo: A complete, edited short story: 1500 words. Character, conflict, resolution — revised twice before considered done.

name: Wearable Tech Design (Paper)
howTo: Design a device that could go on the body: what does it do, how is it powered, what problem does it solve?

name: Book Binding (Pamphlet Stitch)
howTo: Fold and stitch a 16-page booklet with a pamphlet stitch. The book's structure becomes comprehensible.
materials: Paper, needle, wax thread, bone folder

name: Make a Diorama
howTo: A 3D scene in a box: painted background, layered paper elements, miniature figures. Theatrical design thinking.
materials: Cardboard box, paint, paper, small objects

name: Weaving: Rigid Heddle Loom
howTo: Simple table loom: warp, weave, beat, advance. The structure of cloth becomes visible and learnable.

name: Calligraphy: Full Alphabet
howTo: Write the full lowercase alphabet in an italic calligraphic hand. Letterform + pressure + consistency.

name: Novel: 3 Chapters
howTo: Write 3 chapters of an intended longer novel. Sustaining characters across chapters requires planning and consistency.

name: Socratic Seminar
howTo: Guided discussion of a big question with 3+ people: 'Is it ever right to break a rule?' Listen and build on others.

name: Write a Speech
howTo: A 400-word speech on a real topic. Opening hook + 3 arguments + call to action. Rhetoric as a skill.

name: Literary Devices
howTo: Metaphor, simile, personification, alliteration, onomatopoeia — identify and use all 5 in a single paragraph.

name: Letter to Future Self
howTo: Write a letter to open in 5 years: who you are now, what you hope for, what you worry about.

name: Analyse a Speech (Historical)
howTo: Read a famous speech. Identify: the audience, the purpose, 2 rhetorical devices, the call to action.

name: Collaborative Story Writing
howTo: Write alternating chapters with a parent or friend: one person writes chapter 1, the other writes chapter 2.

name: Write a Research Essay
howTo: 400 words with an argument, 3 pieces of evidence from different sources, and a conclusion. Academic writing beginning.

name: Ratio and Proportion
howTo: If 3 cups make 1 batch, how many cups for 2 batches? Proportional reasoning in cooking + mathematics.

name: Angles: Measuring with Protractor
howTo: Measure and draw angles to within 5 degrees. Protractor use = spatial measurement tool.

name: Prime Numbers (1–50)
howTo: Identify prime numbers to 50 using the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Pattern-based mathematical discovery.

name: Volcanoes and Plate Tectonics
howTo: Why do volcanoes happen? Plate tectonics model. Geography + geology + scale comprehension.

name: Photosynthesis Equation
howTo: CO2 + water + light → glucose + oxygen. The equation of life: every plant, every breath.

name: Historical Empathy
howTo: Put yourself in [historical person's] position. What would you have done? What did they know that we don't?'

name: Manage Peer Pressure (Practice)
howTo: Role-play 3 peer pressure scenarios. Practise saying no in different ways: firm, funny, deflecting, leaving.

name: Understand Anxiety (Own)
howTo: What does worry feel like in your body? Where does it live? What are you most worried about right now?'

name: Become a Good Loser and a Good Winner
howTo: Both in the same session: play a game, win one, lose one, respond to each with class. Practice, not performance.

name: Notice Systemic Unfairness
howTo: Why might some people have more advantages than others from the start?' Beginning structural thinking about society.

name: Own Your Mistakes Publicly
howTo: When you've done something wrong that others know about: acknowledge it without excessive excuse-making.

name: Reciprocity in Relationships
howTo: What have you given in your closest friendship this week? What have you received?' Friendship as a two-way exchange.

name: Hydroponics (Simple Setup)
howTo: Grow plants in water + nutrient solution without soil. Modern agriculture + biology + systematic care.

name: Electrolysis (Salt Water)
howTo: Salt water + two pencils + battery = bubbles of hydrogen and oxygen. Electricity splits water. Simple electrolysis.

name: Make a Spectroscope
howTo: CD + cardboard box + light source. Split white light into the spectrum. Optics: dispersion of light.

name: Felting (Wet Felting)
howTo: Wet felting: wool + hot water + soap, agitate until fibres lock. The science of fibre entanglement.
materials: Wool roving, soap, hot water, bubble wrap

name: Ethnobotany Walk
howTo: Walk through a local area: identify plants with traditional or practical uses. Local plant knowledge as science.

name: Financial Literacy: Saving and Interest
howTo: If you save 100 Rs and earn 5% interest per year, how much do you have after a year? Simple interest concept.

name: Cook an International Meal
howTo: Full meal from another country: recipe research, shopping, cooking, plating. Culinary geography.

name: Design a Sport
howTo: Invent a new sport: rules, equipment, team size, scoring. Systems thinking + creativity + fairness all embedded.

name: Swimming: Racing Dive
howTo: Competitive racing dive from the blocks (or pool edge). Explosive entry + streamline = technical swimming milestone.

name: Cycle Touring (Day Trip)
howTo: Plan and execute a 10+ km cycling day trip with stops. Navigation, stamina, rest planning.

name: Advanced Gymnastics Sequence
howTo: 7-element floor sequence with transitions. Choreographed gymnastics: the motor elements are now the canvas, not the goal.

name: Trail Running (3 km)
howTo: Run on uneven terrain for 3 km. Trail running recruits far more stabilising muscles than road running.

name: Yoga Flow (10 Poses)
howTo: 10-pose yoga sequence from memory, held 3 breaths each. Memory + breath + body alignment combined.

name: Tennis: Serve
howTo: Continental grip serve: toss, trophy position, contact, follow through. The serve is the most complex single stroke in tennis.

name: Ultimate Frisbee (Full Game)
howTo: Full game with disc rules, positions, and spirit of the game. Ultimate has a unique self-refereed model.

name: Write a Science Fiction Story
howTo: Set in a plausible future world. Science underpins the fiction: what technology exists, why, and what problem it creates.

name: Pottery: Wheel-Thrown (Supervised)
howTo: Supervised session on a potter's wheel. Centring clay on a moving wheel is the most demanding fine motor task in craft.
materials: Potter's wheel + clay (art school or studio)

name: Knitting: First Garment
howTo: Knit a small rectangular scarf or wash cloth: 20 stitches, 40 rows. A complete, usable knitted object.

name: Build an App (No-Code Platform)
howTo: Build a functional app using a no-code platform. Real-world product: what problem does it solve?
materials: Computer + no-code app platform (MIT App Inventor)

name: Map-Making (Cartography Project)
howTo: Draw an imaginary world with 5 regions, a legend, a scale, compass rose, and geographic features.

name: Make a Documentary (Short)
howTo: Plan, film, and edit a 2-minute documentary about a local topic. Visual storytelling + interviewing + editing.

name: Write a Mystery Story
howTo: A mystery requires: a mystery, red herrings, clues, a reveal, and a resolution. Plotting in reverse: start with the answer.

name: Debate (Cross-Examination Style)
howTo: Statement + cross-examination. One side asks targeted questions to undermine the other's argument. Advanced debate.

name: Write a Personal Manifesto
howTo: These are the things I believe, the things I value, and the kind of person I am working to be.' Identity in writing.

name: Read and Discuss a Banned Book
howTo: Read (or excerpt of) a book that has been banned or challenged. Why? What does this tell us about society?

name: Epistolary Story
howTo: A story told entirely through letters, emails, or diary entries. A distinct narrative structure with its own rules.

name: Etymology Research Project
howTo: Choose 20 words from a single field (cooking, sport, medicine) and trace their origins. Language as historical record.

name: Write a Found Poem
howTo: Take a news article and isolate words to create a poem. Found poetry reveals the poetry already in language.

name: Understand Narrative Unreliability
howTo: Is the narrator telling us everything? Are they being honest?' Unreliable narrator as a literary device.

name: Square Roots (Estimation)
howTo: What is the square root of 50? Between 7 (49) and 8 (64) — closer to 7. Estimation + number sense combined.

name: Coordinate Geometry (4 Quadrants)
howTo: Plot points in all 4 quadrants of a coordinate plane. Negative coordinates = number line extended into space.

name: Speed, Distance, Time
howTo: If I travel 60 km at 30 km/h, how long does it take? The formula and its rearrangements.

name: Genetics Introduction
howTo: Why do children look like parents? Genes carry information. Dominant and recessive traits with Mendel's peas.

name: Climate Science
howTo: Carbon dioxide + solar radiation + greenhouse effect. How does human activity change the climate? Evidence-based.

name: Philosophy of Mind
howTo: How do you know other people are conscious? How do you know YOU are conscious?' Philosophy as lived inquiry.

name: Emotional Regulation Toolkit
howTo: Map your own regulation tools: 5 things that calm you, 3 things that energise you, 2 things that ground you. Personal toolkit.

name: Understand Cognitive Biases
howTo: Confirmation bias: we see what we already believe. Provide an example from own life. Self-awareness as critical thinking.

name: Practice Radical Honesty
howTo: One conversation where you say exactly what you think (with kindness). Honesty as a practice, not just a value.

name: Build a Community Project
howTo: Identify a small problem in your community and design a solution. Civic agency: from observation to action.

name: Understand the News Cycle
howTo: Read the same story from two different publications. What's different? Journalism, framing, and editorial perspective.

name: Comfort Someone in Grief
howTo: When someone you know is grieving: sit with them, listen, don't fix. The skill of simply being present.

name: Build a Radio (Crystal Set)
howTo: Crystal radio receiver: wire antenna, capacitor, crystal diode, earphone. Receives AM radio without power. Electromagnetic field science.

name: Make Indigo Dye (Plant-Based)
howTo: Process indigo leaves (or buy powder) to create a vat. Dye cloth. Reduction chemistry + ancient textile tradition.
materials: Indigo leaves or powder, water, reducing agent

name: Soil Science Investigation
howTo: Test soil pH, texture, and drainage in 3 different spots. What do the results mean for growing food?

name: Build a Kite from Scratch
howTo: Bamboo + tissue paper + string + tail. Design it, test it, adjust it. Aerodynamics through iteration.

name: Night Photography
howTo: Use a phone on night mode: photograph the moon, city lights, star trails (long exposure). Visual + astronomy.

name: Learn Basic First Aid (Certified)
howTo: Complete a basic first aid course (1-day). CPR, choking, burns, bleeding. Actual lifesaving capability.

name: Manage a Week Independently
howTo: For one week, manage own morning routine, school bag, homework, and one household chore without reminders.

name: Coach a Younger Team
howTo: Organise and run a sports activity for 5–8 younger children. Leadership + pedagogy + patience combined.

name: Marathon (Short Distance)
howTo: Run a 5-km 'marathon' with pacing and recovery strategy. Goal-setting + physical training + completion.

name: Bicycle Maintenance
howTo: Fix a puncture, oil the chain, adjust the brakes. Understanding and maintaining one's own tools.
materials: Bicycle, tyre levers, pump, oil, cloth

name: Sport: Full Season Participation
howTo: Commit to a sport for a full season. Regular training + team membership + end-of-season performance or competition.

name: Swimming: Medley
howTo: Individual medley: butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke, freestyle in sequence. The most technically demanding swimming achievement.

name: Mountain Bike Trail
howTo: Trail mountain biking: technical terrain, root avoidance, off-camber sections. Mastery of cycling on a new surface.

name: Dance: Choreograph for an Audience
howTo: Choreograph a 2-minute dance piece and perform it for a real audience. Creative intention + public performance.

name: Free Solo Climbing (Bouldering)
howTo: Unsupported bouldering at an indoor wall: read the route, solve it. Self-directed physical problem-solving.

name: Write a Novella (First 5000 Words)
howTo: Begin a sustained long-form writing project. Plot outline, chapter plan, daily writing practice. Authorial identity.

name: Build a Working Model Engine
howTo: Simple steam engine or electric motor model. How does energy convert into motion? Engineering science.

name: Ceramics: Glazing and Firing
howTo: Apply underglaze and overglaze to bisque-fired piece. Two-stage firing = colour chemistry through heat.

name: Wiring a Simple Plug (Supervised)
howTo: Supervised: identify live, neutral, earth in a plug; connect correctly. Electrical safety + practical knowledge.

name: Photography: Composition Rules
howTo: Rule of thirds, leading lines, framing. Apply all 3 in 5 intentional photos. Visual composition as deliberate craft.

name: Weave a Rug (Small)
howTo: A small rug on a frame loom: warp and weft at density. Sustained repetitive fine motor over a physical project.

name: Read Literature (Original Text)
howTo: Read an original, unabridged classic in full. Grapple with archaic language as a skill, not a barrier.

name: Write a Formal Argument Essay
howTo: 800 words: thesis, 3 body paragraphs with evidence and counter-argument addressed, conclusion. University-essay structure.

name: Public Speaking (External Audience)
howTo: Present to an audience beyond family: school group, community, or recorded. Real audience = real feedback.

name: Write a Research Paper
howTo: Includes a bibliography, quotes with attribution, and a distinct argument. Academic writing conventions.

name: Translate a Short Text
howTo: Translate a simple paragraph to/from a second language. Bilingual flexibility and linguistic comparison.

name: Study and Present on a Person
howTo: In-depth research on one person: 10 facts, a timeline, one thing they changed. Oral presentation.

name: Write a Letter to an Authority
howTo: Write a real letter (or email) to a local councillor, newspaper, or organisation about a real issue.
materials: Pencil and paper or email access

name: Read and Discuss a Dystopian Novel
howTo: A gentle dystopian novel: what is the society afraid of? What does this tell us about our own world?

name: Algebra: Linear Equations
howTo: Solve 2x + 3 = 11. Two-step equations with one variable. Algebraic reasoning + inverse operations.

name: Statistics: Mean, Median, Mode
howTo: Calculate all three for a data set. When would each be misleading? Statistical literacy begins here.

name: Understand Compound Interest
howTo: Interest on interest. Compare simple vs compound over 10 years. The most powerful concept in personal finance.

name: Philosophy: Ethics Trolley Problem
howTo: The trolley problem and its variants. There is no right answer — the process of reasoning is the point.

name: Evolution: Natural Selection
howTo: Survival of the fittest: variation, selection pressure, inherited advantage, generation change. Darwin's mechanism.

name: Study a Civilisation
howTo: Choose one ancient civilisation: research government, economy, culture, fall. Historical systems thinking.

name: Build a Personal Vision
howTo: What kind of person do I want to be at 18? At 30? What do I need to do to become that person?' Long-range identity work.

name: Understand Your Own Learning Style
howTo: How do you learn best? What conditions make you most creative? What drains you? Self-awareness as meta-cognition.

name: Lead a Team Through Difficulty
howTo: When a group project hits a problem: step up, identify the issue, suggest a path forward. Leadership in adversity.

name: Understand Mental Health Continuum
howTo: Mental health is not binary — everyone is somewhere on a continuum. What affects yours? How do you maintain it?

name: Give Something Back
howTo: Identify a skill or resource you have and give it to someone who needs it. Generosity as identity, not event.

name: Identity: Who Am I (Full Reflection)
howTo: Write or tell: your values, your strengths, your challenges, your culture, your aspirations. A portrait in words.

name: Rocketry (Baking Soda + Vinegar Rocket)
howTo: Build a paper rocket body; launch with baking soda + vinegar. Newton's 3rd law + trajectory + design iteration.
materials: Paper, tape, baking soda, vinegar, cork

name: Bread Fermentation (Sourdough Starter)
howTo: Cultivate a sourdough starter over 5 days. Microbiology: wild yeast + bacteria + time = leavening.

name: Night Hike (Moonlit)
howTo: Hike 2 km at night using torchlight or moonlight. Sensory recalibration: vision changes, sound sharpens, fear and awe.

name: Build a Drone (Simple Kit)
howTo: Assemble a simple drone kit. Lift, thrust, pitch, yaw, roll — four rotor forces that enable stable flight.

name: Make a Graphic Novel (First Issue)
howTo: 10 pages: panels, speech bubbles, visual storytelling without verbal narration where possible. Comics as a serious medium.

name: Responsible Technology Use
howTo: Review own technology use across a week: time, content, quality of experience. Intentional use vs reactive use.

name: Life Skills: Sew on a Button, Hem Trousers
howTo: Practical clothing repair. These skills prevent waste and build material self-sufficiency.
